entities.name: Arrus
entities.description: A cold-hearted, runt viashino Gruul tattoo artist of the Ghor Clan who is cast out after his ink burns warriors, learns to make healing ink from Baas Radley, uncovers Selesnya's drain on the Rubblebelt and finds his Rage.

entities.name: Jiri
entities.description: Arrus's littermate and a Ghor warrior who looks after him, is burned by the bad ink, and finally stands with Arrus.

entities.name: Dryzek
entities.description: A legendary eight-hundred-year-old giant berserker newly returned from Udzec who pledges loyalty to Ruric and Thar and encourages Arrus to find his own Rage.

entities.name: Ruric and Thar
entities.description: The two-headed ogre chieftain of the Ghor Clan who exiles Arrus and later joins his call for war against Selesnya.

entities.name: Baas Radley
entities.description: A one-handed ogre shaman and former Gruul warrior who collapsed the Jezeru dams, now a tattoo artist, who teaches Arrus her healing ink.

entities.name: Daeska Sol
entities.description: A cyclops berserker who fought beside Baas, escaped arrest at Tin Street Market and did not wait for her.

entities.name: Raze-Boar
entities.description: The Gruul deity whom the clan honors with tusk-shaped rubble stacks.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of clans devoted to Rage and destroying civilization.

entities.name: Ghor Clan
entities.description: The Gruul clan led by Ruric and Thar that Arrus belongs to.

entities.name: Burning Tree Clan
entities.description: A distant Gruul clan where Baas offers to send Arrus.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The nature guild that plants fast-grown forests along the Rubblebelt and is draining its magic.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild whose labs the Gruul destroy.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild whose blocks and soldiers appear in Gruul battles.

entities.name: Gruul Rubblebelt
entities.description: The ruined wild district of Ravnica that is weakening and dying.

entities.name: Udzec
entities.description: The prison from which Dryzek has just been released.

entities.name: Wargate
entities.description: The Boros prison from which Baas was recently released.

entities.name: Rage
entities.description: The berserk fury that Gruul channel, which Arrus cannot feel until the end.

entities.name: Tin Street Massacre
entities.description: The mass chaos incident at Tin Street Market that led to Baas's arrest.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the story is set.

events.summary: Arrus gathers ingredients for his magical tattoo ink, tampering with the recipe because the maaka scat is poor.
events.quote: so I desperately add more scat to the mix until finally the ink brightens.

events.summary: At the ruined battlefront the Ghor Clan builds rubble tributes and Rage spreads through the crowd, but Arrus can only pretend to feel it.
events.quote: And just like that, Rage ignites.

events.summary: Arrus tattoos Jiri and learns Dryzek may challenge Ruric and Thar for chieftain.
events.quote: I think he's going to challenge Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain,

events.summary: Dryzek tells Arrus that Rage speaks differently to different people, hinting he knows Arrus's heart is cold, and Arrus starts tattooing his arm.
events.quote: I know Rage when I see it, and that ain't it. But it'll find you.

events.summary: Dryzek kneels and offers a roasted drake to Ruric and Thar as a token of loyalty, sealing a blood kinship instead of a coup.
events.quote: The deal is sealed with a blood kinship, and all the walls between factions come crashing down.

events.summary: The ink Arrus made bursts into flame on Jiri, Dryzek and other warriors, and Ruric and Thar cast Arrus out of the clan.
events.quote: Your services are no longer needed here,

events.summary: Clanless, Arrus notices the Rubblebelt's plants, animals and food are all failing and tries to warn Jiri, who refuses to listen.
events.quote: Something's been sucking the life out of the Rubblebelt these last couple months.

events.summary: Arrus tries to steal the ink of the ogre shaman, who beats him up, and Selesnyan vine magic from spilled ink heals him.
events.quote: Slowly, but surely, I feel my broken bones mend.

events.summary: Arrus follows the ogre to a hydra cave where she steals an egg using a goblin skull lure, and they flee together.
events.quote: The ground erupts, spewing rock and stone as a steep ramp forms ahead of us.

events.summary: Arrus recognizes the ogre as Baas Radley, the shaman who collapsed the Jezeru dams.
events.quote: Wait. You're Baas Radley. The shaman who collapsed the Jezeru dams?

events.summary: Baas teaches Arrus to face down a charging battleboar herd and offers to send him to Burning Tree Clan and teach him her ink recipe.
events.quote: You're too good to toss to the Wilds.

events.summary: Baas reveals she was arrested at Tin Street Market and abandoned by Daeska, and why she avoids the front line.
events.quote: I got arrested. Daeska got away.

events.summary: Arrus discovers that trees on the Selesnyan border are only five years old, planted as a fast-grown barrier that leeches magic from the Rubblebelt.
events.quote: Selesnya had planted thousands and thousands of saplings, and then accelerated their growth until they had the perfect impenetrable barrier.

events.summary: Arrus challenges Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain and is beaten, repeatedly defying them.
events.quote: Ruric pounds his huge fist on the top of my head, and I crumple to the ground

events.summary: Arrus finally finds his Rage, rooted in anger at his people's lost stories, and rises from the beating.
events.quote: There's no more pain, only Rage.

events.summary: Arrus tells the clan that Selesnya is draining the Rubblebelt, and Jiri, Baas, Dryzek and others join him in flames.
events.quote: He stands behind me, and my flames all but leap for him.

events.summary: Ruric and Thar accept Arrus's challenge, set themselves alight and declare war on Selesnya.
events.quote: If Selesnya wants a war, we'll give them a war,

relations.quote: Good battle today," grunts Jiri, my littermate

relations.note: A tattoo artist of the clan until exiled.
relations.quote: the fire within the hearts of the Ghor Clan—well, most of us
expressing their support for our clan leaders

relations.note: She teaches him her ink recipe and combat tricks.
relations.quote: I'll show you how to make the ink.

relations.note: Selesnya drains the Rubblebelt's magic to grow its barrier forest.
relations.quote: And they've been leaching magic from our lands to do it

relations.note: Daeska was her partner but did not wait for her.
relations.quote: Turns out, I got released early, only to find out that tramp hadn't even waited ten months.

relations.note: He pledges loyalty to them as chieftains.
relations.quote: A token, my chieftain, of my loyalty to Ghor Clan.
